title: S8 Classification Mapping and Carrier Fields

entries.name: Mapping Rule ID
entries.description: Stable identifier for a mapping rule.

entries.name: Source Type
entries.description: Source model/content type used by the rule, such as category, family type, space type, asset type, or information-container class.

entries.name: Source Scope
entries.description: Explicit source selection or applicability condition for the rule.

entries.name: Target System ID
entries.description: Governed classification system referenced by the mapping.

entries.name: Target Code-Set ID
entries.description: Governed code set referenced by the mapping.

entries.name: Target Code Reference
entries.description: Code or governed code reference produced by the mapping; the authoritative code list remains external to this field registry.

entries.name: Mapping Logic Summary
entries.description: Human- and machine-readable description of the mapping basis.

entries.name: Owning Authority / Steward
entries.description: Governed role or team responsible for the mapping rule.

entries.name: Effective From
entries.description: Date, version, or project condition from which the mapping applies.

entries.name: Carrier ID
entries.description: Stable identifier for the parameter or data carrier used to store the classification value.

entries.name: Parameter Reference
entries.description: Reference to the governed parameter/shared-parameter registry entry or equivalent governed carrier.

entries.name: Applicable Discipline / Model Types
entries.description: Scope in which the carrier is valid.

entries.name: Expected Data Type / Format
entries.description: Expected storage type, code syntax, or reference format for the classification value.

entries.name: Deviation / Exception Route
entries.description: Governed path for approved departures from the mapping or carrier rule.

governance_notes: Mapping rules must reference governed classification systems/code sets rather than uncontrolled local codes.
Carrier definitions should resolve to the governed shared-parameter registry or another explicitly governed semantic carrier.
Tool-specific assignment methods belong in instructions, not this registry.
Ad-hoc project mappings require explicit project governance and do not silently become enterprise standards.

provenance.migration_note: GAP-S8-02 mapping-rule and carrier governance fields migrated without inventing code mappings or parameter names.
